svg.title: Measuring blood pressure with a cuff
svg.desc: As cuff pressure falls from 160 to 60 millimeters of mercury, the artery stays closed above the systolic 120, opens in turbulent spurts that make sounds between 120 and 80, and flows smoothly and silently below the diastolic 80. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Reading blood pressure as the cuff deflates
Cuff above systolic: artery closed, silent
Between: spurts of turbulent flow, sounds
Schematic 120/80 mm Hg pulse. Sounds start when cuff pressure drops below the peak (systolic) and
stop when it drops below the minimum (diastolic).
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
